title: [Control systems] CODESYS security advisory (AV26-983)
description: As of September 30, 2026, CODESYS is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:

	Prior to 4.23.0.0

CODESYS Control for WAGO Touch Panels 600 SL
	Prior to 4.23.0.0

CODESYS Control for emPC-A/iMX6 SL
	Prior to 4.23.0.0

CODESYS Edge Gateway for Linux
	Prior to 4.23.0.0

CODESYS Edge Gateway for Windows
	Prior to 3.5.22.40

CODESYS OPC DA Server SL
